blocks.text: A weekly review on Friday afternoon keeps the inbox at zero, in week 7 of the plan.
The kitchen shelves can hold the cookbooks if we drop the top one, in week 7 of the plan.
Two easy runs a week are enough to keep the base mileage up, in week 7 of the plan.
The migration is safe because every write goes to both databases, in week 7 of the plan.
Notes in the margin help me remember more of what I read, in week 7 of the plan.
Watering in the evening loses less to the sun than the morning does, in week 7 of the plan.
